text: SUNNToCACF is an option of SUNSimplify and CalcColorFactor. If set to True, the Casimir operator eigenvalues CA (=n_c) and CF (=(n_c^2-1)/(2 n_c)) are reconstructed from the result in terms of \(n_c\) using heuristics. The reconstruction is not always perfect, but mostly sufficient at tree and one-loop level.
